dataset_type: public GitHub README development review sample
sampling_policy: 32 repositories from an initial bounded topic:vibe-coding search, created within preceding 90 days. This initial sample exposed older-partition bias; production discovery was subsequently changed to newest partitions and author-declaration queries first. Not a random or representative ecosystem sample.
limitations: Agent reviewed repository descriptions, README introductions and candidate author-development statements. Unblinded development sample; rules were refined on this set. Not independent human annotations or a held-out benchmark.
